skills.name: Find Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions with like denominators.

skills.name: Subtract Whole Numbers
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer or whole number components of operands.

skills.name: Subtract Fractions
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions with like denominators.

skills.name: Regroup or Borrow
skills.definition: Borrowing one or more wholes from the integer part to resolve a negative fraction subtraction result.

skills.name: Simplify Fractions
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms after performing subtraction.
